verseText: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
meaning: There are many things in life to think about and worry about. But Jesus teaches us to put God's kingdom and what is right before everything else, trusting God to take care of what we need.

recall.question: What does Jesus tell us to seek first?

meaning.question: What does it mean to “seek first” the kingdom of God?
choices: To make knowing God most important
To read your Bible when you wake up each morning
To look for God's buried treasure

application.prompt: With so many things to think about, it's easy to forget what matters most. Jesus tells us to put God first and trust our heavenly Father to care for our needs. What is one choice you could make today that puts God's kingdom first?
